# Codes of conduct

These codes of conduct apply to all contributor activity, including but not limited to comments, commits, pull requests, issues, wiki edits, and discussions.

Contributors to repositories hosted by `alphagov` must follow the [Contributor Covenant Code of Conduct](https://github.com/alphagov/.github/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

Contributors to repositories managed by the GOV.UK Design System team must also follow [the GOV.UK Design System's Code of Conduct](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/community/code-of-conduct/). See [the govuk-design-system-team tag](https://github.com/topics/govuk-design-system-team) for a list of repositories.

Contributors working in Government are also expected to follow the [Civil Service Code](https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/civil-service-code/the-civil-service-code).
